ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs 1,500 per hospitalization (SI 3L); Rs 2,000 per hospitalization (SI 5/7/10L).

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to 10% of SI for treatment exceeding 3 days.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Alternative treatments up to Rs 15,000 (SI 3L) or Rs 20,000 (SI 5/7/10L).

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual health check-up for all insured members.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic recharge once per policy year up to SI.

room_rent_capping: 1% of SI per day (SI 3L); Single Private AC Room up to 1% of SI per day (SI 5/7/10L).
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-payment per claim if entry age >=61 years; additional 20% co-pay if hospitalization outside Smart Select network.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Rs 20,000 per eye (SI 3L); Rs 30,000 per eye (SI 5/7/10L)
